title: Eligibility Refresh, Secondary Payment and Retroactive Terms — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
These figures govern how fresh an eligibility response must be, how each payer class of **Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility** behaves when it sits behind another coverage, QMB billing, and retroactive eligibility.

## Eligibility and crossover

| Payer class | Maximum age of last eligibility response (calendar days) | Claim crosses over to the secondary automatically when this class is primary |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 90 | yes |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 30 | no |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 30 | no |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 30 | no |
| Commercial HMO | 30 | no |
| Commercial PPO | 30 | no |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 90 | yes |

The first column is the maximum age in calendar days of the last eligibility response before a rental month, shipment or delivery may be billed to the class. The second records whether a claim adjudicated by the class as primary crosses over to the secondary payer automatically, without a separate secondary claim.

## Behaviour when the class is secondary

| Payer class | Pays the primary's deductible portion | Share of the primary's coinsurance portion it pays (percent) | Non-crossover secondary claim must be filed within (calendar days after primary adjudication) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | no | 0 | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | no | 0 | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | no | 0 | 0 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | yes | 100 | 180 |
| Commercial HMO | yes | 80 | 90 |
| Commercial PPO | yes | 80 | 120 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | no | 100 | 365 |

## QMB and retroactive eligibility

| Payer class | A QMB flag on the class forbids billing the patient any Medicare deductible or coinsurance | Retroactive eligibility (calendar days before the application date) |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | no | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | no | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | no | 0 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | yes | 90 |
| Commercial HMO | no | 0 |
| Commercial PPO | no | 0 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | no | 0 |

Retroactive eligibility is the number of calendar days before the application date for which the class can grant retroactive eligibility, making earlier patient charges rebillable.

## Example (hypothetical)

Behind a primary that left a coinsurance portion of 50.00, a Commercial PPO record in the secondary position pays 80 percent of that portion, 40.00; a Medicare Supplement Plan G record pays 100 percent, 50.00.
